Take real ownership and bring your own ideas into products that are used by leading companies in Switzerland.

job.title: Intern – Python Development & Data Analysis
job.description:
Company Description
At PQ Technologies AG (PQT), we build data processing solutions for the financial industry, working with both structured and unstructured data. Our focus is the End-to-End Compliance & Risk process at banks and financial institutions, in particular Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money-Laundering (AML).
We are a multidisciplinary team of 10–15 people in Zurich, combining deep domain expertise in Compliance & Risk with strong engineering capabilities. Our software runs inside our clients' critical processes at leading financial institutions, tested and relied on daily.
Role Description
We are looking for an intern for a paid, 6-month fixed-term internship, supporting the development of data processing and evaluation systems on top of our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine, for leading financial institutions. You'll work closely with our engineers and our Compliance & Risk specialists, and contribute to projects that go live with our clients.
Key responsibilities
Develop (Python) code for data processing and evaluation on our Nucleus Compliance & Risk Engine
Perform data analysis on real datasets in the KYC/AML domain
Support the delivery teams with analysis, testing, documentation and preparation of client sessions
What you will gain
Experience in delivering production-ready code
Practical experience with LLM supported applications in production
Insight into B2B customer communication with regulated financial institutions, and into how client projects are delivered
Direct mentoring from senior engineers and real ownership of your work
Location & commitment
Hybrid — Zurich office, with remote days
Fixed-term internship, 6 months, 70–100%
Start date: 1 September 2026
CHF 4,200 gross per month (paid internship)
No relocation support and no visa sponsorship; travel is limited to occasional client meetings
Extension or permanent role possible after the internship
Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a BSc or MSc in a STEM field at a Swiss university, or a recent graduate
Programming knowledge and experience in Python
A good understanding of algorithms and data structures
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with different types of duties
Valid permission to work in Switzerland
The drive to work independently and pick up new things across different areas
Nice to have — experience working on code collaboratively
No prior compliance or finance knowledge is expected. We care more about attitude and curiosity than a long list of prior experience — we're there to support you, and we're looking for self-starters.

A leading pharmaceutical company is looking for a Junior AI & Knowledge Engineer based in Zurich, Switzerland
Duration: 2-4 months
Start date: 1st October 2026
Workload: 40-80%
Language: English/ German an advantage

We are looking for a highly motivated Master student to support strategic AI and Knowledge
Management initiatives within a global biopharmaceutical environment. The role will work closely with
the MSAT Knowledge Management Lead and contribute to the design and deployment of the AI Academy,
Data Academy, Process Wiki / Knowledge Navigator, and related AI-enabled knowledge solutions.
The assignment is ideal for a student who enjoys building at the intersection of AI tools, knowledge
management, knowledge graph design, information architecture, and user-centric digital product design.

AI Academy & Data Academy development
Support the design of learning pathways, training curricula, capability frameworks and bootcamp

Create AI use case catalogues, prompt examples and practical demonstrations for knowledge work,
data work and process intelligence.
Support launch communication, stakeholder updates and executive-ready summaries.
Process Wiki / Knowledge Navigator
Support the design of a modern digital knowledge infrastructure for process knowledge, process data
and modelling-related content.
Create intuitive navigation structures & page concepts
Develop page mock-ups, wireframes and proof-of-concept knowledge portal designs.
Improve discoverability through taxonomy, metadata and search-oriented content structuring.
Contribute to the integration concept for multiple knowledge sources into a unified knowledge navigator
experience.

Apply AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cowork or comparable AI assistant platforms to
accelerate content creation, knowledge structuring and prototyping.
Support conceptual knowledge graph design by defining entities, relationships and metadata patterns
across documents, processes & systems.
Evaluate approaches for semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation and AI-assisted knowledge
retrieval.
Contribute to concepts for Copilot / Cowork-based assistants, process wiki agents and AI-enabled
knowledge workflows.
Document design decisions, assumptions and recommendations in a structured and reusable way.
